svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: phu screen: selecting contigs that carry chosen protein families
Database names are resolved from the pinned phu-db archive into models:
Predictions are cached: a new screen of the same contigs with other models skips this step
A hit counts when it passes the model's gathering cutoff (--cut-ga, KOfam thresholds)
or, for models without one, E-value ≤ 1e-5 (--max-evalue) and --min-bitscore if given.
The best hit per model is kept on each contig (--top-per-contig 1).
Which models hit each contig decides whether the contig is kept
at least one model hits the contig
every queried model hits the contig
at least --min-hmm-hits models hit the contig
The query and the rule used are written to .phu/query.json
Optional: turn the hits into new models
Proteins that hit each model, from kept contigs only, can seed a model of your own data
lowers bit scores; off by default.
per-domain hits, one per HMM file
A matched contig carries sequence similarity to the queried families; it is not a functional or taxonomic assignment.
Contigs, genes and hits shown are illustrative
